Backup Power.note:
Backup power:
- Open the Wisconsin Public Service news release from August 2023 at https://news.wisconsinpublicservice.com/wps-strengthens-reliability-with-state-of-the-art-generation-facility-near-wausau/. The second paragraph says the units at the natural gas facility 'have begun full operations, sending energy to the electric grid'.
- The Department of Natural Resources final air permit 21-RAB-082 at https://apps.dnr.wi.gov/warp_ext/AM_DownloadObject.aspx?id=1083233 authorizes seven natural gas engines as 'electric generating units' and lists a separate emergency generator. So the seven engines are grid units, not backup power.
